verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'during the 98th Academy Awards in Hollywood on March 15'; R2: 'March 15, 2026... the 98th Academy Awards'; R4: 'on March 15, 2026'; R6: 'March 15, 2026'; R7: '2026 Oscars on Sunday, March 15'; R8: 'March 15, 2026'

verifications.claim: The tie marks the seventh tie in Oscar history.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Ties have happened six times previously'; R2: 'the seventh time'; R3: 'whopping seven ties'; R5: 'six other ties'; R6: 'the seventh time'; R7: 'only the seventh time'; R8: 'only the seventh tie ever'
verifications.reasoning: Most sources state or imply this is the seventh tie (six previous); minor variation in R4 on counting does not contradict.

verifications.claim: A tie occurred in Best Actress in 1969.

verifications.reasoning: Sources contradict on year: some specify 1969 (ceremony year), others 1968 (eligibility year), for the same Best Actress tie.
